test_title: PYST 47: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

By this time next year / I will had graduated from college / and started my first job / in the field of marketing.

options.text: I will had graduated from college

solution:
The correct answer is 4 i.e. this part of the sentence contains a grammatical error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "I will had graduated from college" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct construction for future perfect tense is "will have" plus the past participle of the verb. Therefore, it should be "I will have graduated from college".

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *By this time next year, I will have graduated from college and started my first job in the field of marketing.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The future perfect tense is used to describe an action that will be completed before a specified point in the future.
 
• The structure for the future perfect tense is: "will have" + [past participle].
